ds2.1.6:63.3: ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññe pi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammā --
ds2.1.6:64.2: Yo tasmiṃ samaye phasso phusanā . . . pe . . .
ds2.1.6:64.3: ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti . . . pe . . . 424.
ds2.1.6:65.1: Katamā tasmiṃ samaye cittass' ekaggatā hoti?
ds2.1.6:65.2: Yā tasmiṃ samaye cittassa ṭhiti . . . pe . . .
ds2.1.6:65.3: ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittass' ekaggatā hoti . . . pe . . . 425.
ds2.1.6:66.2: Yā tasmiṃ samaye kaṅkhā kaṅkhāyanā kaṅkhāyitattaṃ vimati vicikicchā dveḷhakaṃ dvedhāpatho saṃsayo anekaṃsagāho āsappanā parisappanā apariyogāhanā thambhitattaṃ cittassa mano vilekho --
ds2.1.6:66.3: ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye vicikicchā hoti . . . pe . . .
ds2.1.6:66.4: ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññe pi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammā --
ds2.1.6:67.1: Tasmiṃ kho pana samaye cattāro khandhā honti, dvāyatanāni honti, dve dhātuyo honti, tayo āhārā honti, cattāri indriyāni honti, caturaṅgikaṃ jhānaṃ hoti, duvaṅgiko maggo hoti, tīni balāni honti, eko hetu hoti, eko phasso hoti . . . pe . . . ekaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ hoti, ekā dhammadhātu hoti,
ds2.1.6:67.2: ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññe pi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammā --
ds2.1.6:68.2: Phasso cetanā vitakko vicāro cittassekaggatā viriyindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ micchāsaṅkappo micchāvāyāmo viriyabalaṃ ahirikabalaṃ anottappabalaṃ vicikicchā moho ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ paggāho --
ds2.1.6:68.3: ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññe pi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammā -- ṭhapetvā vedanākkhandhaṃ ṭhapetvā saññākkhandhaṃ ṭhapetvā viññāṇakkhandhaṃ --
ds2.1.6:68.4: ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye saṅkhārakkhandho hoti . . . pe . . .
ds2.1.6:69.2: Yasmiṃ samaye akusalaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ hoti upekkhāsahagataṃ uddhaccasampayuttaṃ rūpārammaṇaṃ vā . . . pe . . .
ds2.1.6:69.3: yam yam vā panārabbha -- tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti, vedanā hoti, saññā hoti, cetanā hoti, cittaṃ hoti, vitakko hoti, vicāro hoti, upekkhā hoti, cittass' ekaggatā hoti, viriyindriyaṃ hoti, samādhindriyaṃ hoti, manindriyam hoti, upekkhindriyaṃ hoti, jīvitindriyaṃ hoti, micchāsaṅkappo hoti, micchāvāyāmo hoti, micchāsamādhi hoti, viriyabalaṃ hoti, samādhibalaṃ hoti, ahirikabalaṃ hoti, anottappabalaṃ hoti, uddhaccaṃ hoti, moho hoti, ahirikaṃ hoti, anottappaṃ hoti, samatho hoti, paggāho hoti,
ds2.1.6:69.4: ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññe pi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammā --
ds2.1.6:70.2: Yo tasmiṃ samaye phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusitattaṃ --
ds2.1.6:71.2: Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittassa uddhaccaṃ avūpasamo cetaso vikkhepo bhantattaṃ cittassa:
ds2.1.6:71.3: idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye uddhaccaṃ hoti . . . pe . . .
ds2.1.6:71.4: ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññe pi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammā:
ds2.1.6:72.1: Tasmiṃ kho pana samaye cattāro khandhā honti, dvāyatanāni hoti, dve dhātuyo honti, tayo āhārā honti, pañcindriyāni honti, caturaṅgikaṃ jhānaṃ hoti, tivaṅgiko maggo hoti, cattāri balāni honti, eko hetu hoti, eko phasso hoti . . . pe . . . ekaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ hoti, ekā dhammadhātu hoti:
ds2.1.6:72.2: ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññe pi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammā --
ds2.1.6:73.2: Phasso cetanā vitakko vicāro cittass' ekaggatā viriyindriyaṃ samādhindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ micchāsaṅkappo micchāvāyāmo micchāsamādhi viriyabalaṃ samādhibalaṃ ahirikabalaṃ anottappabalaṃ uddhaccaṃ moho ahirikaṃ anottappaṃ samatho paggāho avikkhepo
ds2.1.6:73.3: ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññe pi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammā ṭhapetvā vedanākkhandhaṃ ṭhapetvā saññākkhandhaṃ ṭhapetvā viññāṇakkhandhaṃ --
ds2.1.6:73.4: ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye saṅkhārakkhandho hoti . . . pe . . .
